decisions.reason: Restricting the available theme-color options does not necessarily change the required bullet sizing, spacing, alignment, visual reference, or existing green fourth-level bullet color.
The prescribed style system must still be deployed consistently; restricting palette options does not alter its catalog source or deployment rule.
Theme-color availability does not affect Tab-based list hierarchy behavior or resolve its existing interaction ambiguity.
The palette restriction does not change the required style-name prefix, its applicability, or the unresolved naming issue.
Limiting available theme colors does not change any specified font size, weight, style, family, or caption typography.
Theme palette options are independent of numbered-list alignment and numbering-style behavior.
The palette restriction does not change automatic word wrapping or containment of the neighboring column.
Theme-color availability does not alter the Board Meeting field-alignment rule.
The palette restriction does not affect the behavior of borders when inserting a line after a Topic.
Restricting theme colors does not change the calendar-dropdown method or the date-field contexts.
The available theme colors do not affect fixed margins or protection of the adjacent pencil icon.
The palette restriction does not change support for multiline entry using a normal hard return.
